summary: Zentek Ltd., a Canadian graphene technology company, filed a Form 6-K announcing that its common shares were approved for trading on the OTCQX Best Market under ticker ZTEKF starting September 2, 2026, following a Nasdaq delisting. Trading on Nasdaq is expected to be suspended the same date; Zentek will request a hearing to appeal the delisting determination, though the appeal will not stay the suspension. Shares continue to trade on the TSX Venture Exchange under ZEN. The company states the transition will not materially impact operations, and shareholders need not act. Watch for the Nasdaq Hearings Panel outcome and OTCQX market maker support.
